title: Which target company gets the first worked ABP?
detail: abp@web-summit.dinis's section: one worked ABP per target company in the factory (WS-27), once Nimay or Indi names the company. The factory has 28 'meet' companies (people/indi/factory/). Name one or three to start, and where it should live (the company's factory page, or content/abp/).
recommend: Start with one whose agents act for its customers and whose public docs say what they can do, so the Reach can be sourced, not guessed.
